source: TIME
Game Saved!
In the land of KoHo, common are the sacrifices of maidens,#in hope of recreating the world as a better place to live.
target: 在科霍大陆，人们常以少女献祭，#期盼将世界重塑得更加美好。

source: Not all accept the rituals, though.##An orphan girl, who has lost her mother to these rituals,#entered a forbidden land, in search of a particular item.
target: 但并非人人都认同这种仪式。##一名孤女的母亲死于献祭，#她踏入禁地，寻找一件秘宝。

source: ##The legends say that this sacred item can even#bring the dead back to life, but for a certain price...
target: ##传说这件圣物甚至能让死者复生，#但必须付出某种代价……

source: Q - changes weapons     S - uses weapon#W - changes item       D - uses item#you can use the boomerang to hit those red crystals#and the reverse-gravity boots to go upside down.
target: Q 切换武器　S 使用武器#E 切换道具　D 使用道具#用回旋镖击打红色水晶，#用反重力靴即可倒立行走。

source: So a mere human like you has made this far into this forbidden place...
target: 区区人类，居然能深入这片禁地……

source: I am Lamia, the Underworld Queen.
target: 我是拉弥亚，冥界的女王。

source: You dare to come down here, believing in a stupid legend about fooling#death...
target: 你竟敢闯入此地，只因相信那个#能欺瞒死亡的愚蠢传说……

source: Those who seek ways to fool death will only meet eternal doom#themselves!
target: 妄图欺瞒死亡之人，#只会让自己陷入永恒的毁灭！

source: ...I've been waiting for someone like you for a long time.#It's time to have some fun!
target: ……我等你这样的人，已经很久了。#是时候找点乐子了！

source: Give me your best shot, if you are prepared for the void!
target: 若你已做好坠入虚无的准备，#就使出你的全力吧！

source: Ughh...!
Let's see how you face this!!
Gah! Is the will to see your mother that strong...?!
target: 可恶！你想再见母亲的愿望，#竟然如此强烈……？！

source: Fine, but you'll regret your decision! Hi ha ha!
target: 好吧，但你会后悔这个决定的！#嘻哈哈！

source: ...It's probably hard for you to see me like this.
target: ……看见这样的我，#你一定很难过吧。

source: My daughter, what you have done for your mother is really admirable.
target: 我的女儿，你为母亲所做的一切，#真的非常了不起。

source: But unfortunately... I can't come back to life. I was chosen as one of the#holy sacrifices for an eventual recreation of this world.
target: 可是……我无法复生。我已被选中，#为重塑这个世界而成为神圣的祭品。

source: We can't disobey the will of the gods. It had to be done and nothing can#change that back.
target: 我们不能违背众神的意志。#此事已成定局，无法挽回。

source: I'm sorry. I understand the pain you've been through...
target: 对不起。#我明白你一路承受了多少痛苦……

source: Please accept this as a last gift from your mother.#I love you...
target: 请收下母亲送给你的最后一份礼物。#我爱你……

source: This is your first gun, the ESP gun. #You can switch weapons with the Q button.
target: 这是你的第一把枪——超能力枪。#按 Q 键可切换武器。

source: You can jump by pressing A and attack by pressing S.#Press Down to advance text.
target: 按 A 跳跃，按 S 攻击。#按方向下键继续对话。

source: You can also check your inventory by pressing Enter.
target: 按 Enter 键还可以查看物品栏。

source: Yokii: You haven't seen a witch with a large green hat or a tiny robo#bunny, have you?
target: 优姬：你有没有见过戴大绿帽的魔女，#或者一只小小的机器兔？

source: If you see them, tell them you never saw me.
target: 要是见到了，就说你没见过我。

source: You can use the Boomerang to hit objects out of your reach.#Select it with E and press D to use it.
target: 回旋镖可以击打远处的物体。#按 E 选中它，再按 D 使用。

source: This is the Karst Gatling, an automatic gun.#Its bullets are weak but it shoots pretty fast.
target: 这是卡斯特加特林，一把自动枪。#子弹威力虽小，射速却很快。

source: The Colt Single Action Army. The greatest handgun ever made.#Enjoy its destructive power.
target: 柯尔特单动式陆军——最棒的手枪。#尽情享受它的破坏力吧。

source: This shield can be activated by selecting it with E and pressing D.#It holds four orbs and has a slow recharge time.
target: 按 E 选中护盾，再按 D 启动。#它能容纳四颗光球，充能较慢。

source: Are you familiar with the Conami Code?
This is the Chaser Bazooka, a homing-missile weapon. The missiles are#weak but may prove to be useful.
target: 这是追踪火箭筒，能发射追踪导弹。#导弹威力较弱，但或许能派上用场。

source: This is the final destination. There is no turning back now.
target: 这里就是终点。#现在已经没有回头路了。

source: Magic Leaf
Your first weapon, a magic leaf capable of great#cutting powers.
target: 你的第一件武器。#一片具有强大切割能力的魔法叶。

source: Golden Flower
The sunflower worn by the Sun Priestess, Mama#Quilla.
target: 太阳女祭司玛玛·基利亚#佩戴的向日葵。

source: Moon Flower
A legendary rose that shines upon Fullmoon nights.
target: 传说中的玫瑰，#会在满月之夜绽放光芒。

source: Acursed Bell
The bell which calls the demon cat, Bakeneko.
Hairpin
A type of hairpin worn by the holy maidens from#the Eos tribe.
target: 伊奥斯部落的圣女们#佩戴的一种发簪。

source: 2YO Doll
A very stupid doll.#Some idiot must have made it.
target: 一个非常蠢的玩偶。#一定是哪个笨蛋做出来的。

source: Squid Hat (ika)
An absolutely cute white hat from the depths of a#pixelated ocean.
target: 来自像素海洋深处的白色帽子。#实在可爱极了。

source: White Mask
A plain white mask. Somehow you feel a strange#aura from it.
target: 一张普通的白色面具。#你却隐约感到一股奇怪的气息。

source: Purply's Crown
Crown once blessed with the power of Life,#previously atop a purple tower.
target: 这顶王冠曾受生命之力祝福，#原本置于一座紫色高塔之上。

source: Love Letter
A L-love letter?! Who might have sent it...?!
target: 情、情书？！#到底是谁寄来的……？！

source: Bird Statue
The statue of a bird who traded one of his eyes#for the ability to fly through time.
target: 这只鸟曾以一只眼睛为代价，#换取穿越时光的能力。

source: Pause Fairy
A fairy that only appears in the pause screen.#She is known for her useless advices.
target: 只会出现在暂停画面的妖精。#以提供毫无用处的建议而闻名。

source: Traveler's Journal
The adventure log and memory journal of a#traveller.
target: 一位旅人的冒险记录与回忆。

source: Time Egg
Delicious egg if fried... But some prefer to use it as#a Time Machine.
target: 煎着吃一定很美味……#但有人更愿把它当作时光机。

source: Shell Fruit
Long ago, one thousand of them fell from the sky.#Unbelievably delicious, despite the odd shape.
target: 很久以前，一千颗贝壳果从天而降。#外形虽古怪，却美味得不可思议。
